nodes.klein: to be as sweet as honey. was as sweet as honey. he made as sweet as honey. it turned sour, fermented; he sweetened.

nodes.g: to be or become weak, be or become sick, be or become diseased, be or become grieved, be…
to catch, handle, lay hold, take hold of, seize, wield
to be gross, be insensitive, be fat
to be or become sweet or pleasing
‘Mem’ — the thirteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet
